purpose: Test whether nonlinear interactions with an exact transported raw20 state bank improve q10:q15 reconstruction beyond the promoted all688 22-input q-head.

data_contract.native_rows: all frozen target-free Q24 native rows, role ranks 0:687
data_contract.targets: sealed observer_fit mlp_id and all_layer_means only

frozen_candidate.architecture: 42 -> 64 SiLU -> 64 SiLU -> six layer-specific scalar heads
frozen_candidate.original_features: standardized raw20 + alpha=.75 J state/rms + local J innovation/(sigma*rms)
frozen_candidate.new_features: twenty per-coordinate standardized transported raw20 states Z_l
frozen_candidate.normalization: per-layer/channel center and RMS over all688 target-free Z values; clamp at +/-8
frozen_candidate.loss: mean six-layer squared source error normalized by training-fold q_rms

comparison.authority: the exact persisted 22-input full688 four-fold OOF result; its arm is not retrained

promotion_gate.primary_metric: pooled final-layer raw MSE across all688 OOF predictions
promotion_gate.rationale: 0.25% clears the prior linear transported-bank gain of 0.228% and requires broad network transfer

target_blind_shrink_diagnostic.selection_use: diagnostic only; it cannot change recurrence, architecture, folds, epoch, or gate

outcome_law.success: persist one all688 epoch13 scientific model only after every OOF gate passes
outcome_law.failure: persist result and close nonlinear transported-bank lane
